def transform(grid):
    # Solid horizontal and vertical lines partition the input into panels.
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    for ra, rb in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        if rb == ra + 1:
            continue
        row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            if cb == ca + 1:
                continue
            tile = [grid[r][ca+1:cb] for r in range(ra+1, rb)]
            vals = [v for rr in tile for v in rr]
            # Most frequent tile color is its background; all other cells are marks.
            bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            row.append((bg, sum(v != bg for v in vals) > 1))
        panels.append(row)
    return [[1 if marked else bg for bg, marked in row] for row in panels]
